card.text: Explore Susi in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Coarse lightcurve reconstruction, with an approximate size from infrared observations. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Infrared diameter 21.82 ± 1.4 km; the quoted error covers flux precision only, not shape or thermal-model assumptions. This coarse convex model has uncertain shape and pole; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 10.91 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
